rows.title_full:
AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE BASES CONVERSION AND DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITY AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7227,
OTHERWISE KNOWN AS “THE BASES CONVERSION AND DEVELOPMENT
ACT OF 1992”, AS AMENDED
rows.title_short:
Strengthening The Bases Conversion And Development
Authority Amending For The Purpose Republic Act No. 7227, Otherwise Known As “ The Bases Conversion And Development Act Of 1992”, As Amended
rows.abstract:
Seeks to extend the term of Bases Conversation and Development Authority (BCDA) for another fifty (50) years upon the expiration of its original term, and may be further extended by law.
Increases the authorized capital of BCDA from P100 billion to P400 billion which may be fully subscribed by the Republic of the Philippines and funded either in cash or property.
Declares residential land and residential mixed-use land identified by the BCDA in its Master Development Plans for the economic zones identified and defined under RA 7227, as amended, as alienable and disposable.
Provides that area to be classified as alienable and disposable subject to sale shall not be more than 5% of the total land area of each economic zone, the proceeds from the sale shall accrue to the Conversion Authority.
rows.status: Vetoed by the President on 2025-04-24

AN ACT MANDATING THE FORMULATION, FINANCING, IMPLEMENTATION, MONITORING, AND EVALUATION OF A COMPREHENSIVE AND MULTI-YEAR "TATAK PINOY" (PROUDLY
FILIPINO) STRATEGY, ESTABLISHING A TATAK PINOY COUNCIL, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Tatak Pinoy ( Proudly Filipino ) Act
rows.abstract:
Aims to improve and diversify local enterprises and their linkages with value chains through strategy that shall include plans and programs relating to 1) manpower, 2) infrastructure, 3) technology and innovation, 4) investments, and 5) public fiscal management and government procurement.
Seeks to establish a Council that has the authority to develop and monitor effective implementation of the TPS to include the identification of public-private initiatives and government support for each targeted sector.
Intends to support and promote the production and offering of Filipino-made products, goods, and services of increasing diversity, sophistication, and quality by local enterprises - that are globally competitive and recognized as a world-class brand.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A COMPREHENSIVE AND RATIONALIZED GRANT OF REWARDS TO INFORMERS FOR THE DISCOVERY OF VIOLATIONS OF INTERNAL REVENUE AND CUSTOMS LAWS
rows.abstract:
Seeks to incentivize individuals to report tax evasion and noncompliance to relevant authorities and ensure that the rewards should be proportionate to the information provided and the amount of tax recovered.
Proposes specific provisions among others as follows: 
a) informer´s reward for the discovery of fraud related to the NIRC or violations of any of the provisions thereof; b) informer´s reward for the discovery and seizure of smuggled goods - equivalent to a percentage of the actual proceeds of the sale of such confiscated goods, or of the actual collection of additional revenues, etc. ;  c) non-payment of informer´s reward (if there is nothing actually recovered or collected . . . ; d) confidentiality of informer´s identification; e) action in cases involving false of malicious information; f) automatic appropriation of all proceeds resulting from the recovery of revenues, surcharges, fees, and/or imposition of fine penalty, and/or from the sale of smuggled and confiscated goods.

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE WASTE WORKERS´ HEALTH AND WELFARE PROGRAM AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Defines “Waste Worker” to refer to any person engaged in the collection, transportation, processing, and disposal of solid waste, and includes, but is not limited to, garbage collectors, waste pickers, recyclers, and landfill and dumpsite workers.
Proposes to safeguard and promote the rights and welfare of waste workers in the country which shall include the ff. components:
a) Registration and Monitoring System; b) Health Coverage and Benefits; c) Occupational Safety Training; d) Personal Protective Equipment; e) Educational Assistance; f) Financial Assistance.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 2023-07-25

rows.author: E018;
rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE ESTABLISHMENT AND USE OF ONLINE PHARMACIES IN THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract:
Seeks to regulate the establishment and use of “eBotika” in the sale and distribution of drugs, medicines, and medical devices in the country.
Aims to address several issues among others related to:  1) proliferation of illegal online sale of drugs and medicines and drug trafficking activities; 2) online sale of unregistered products such as medical devices, cosmetics and food supplements; 3) streamlined licensing process and regular monitoring of online pharmacy services; 4) a secure online platform, adequate inventory of pharmaceutical products and implementation of quality control measures; 5) verification of patient´s identity, etc. and electronic prescriptions; drug orders´ submission by multiple pharmacies; 6) patient´s medication profiles, confidentiality of their personal and sensitive information when transmitted over the internet, etc.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 2023-07-25

rows.title_full: AN ACT FURTHER AMENDING CERTAIN SECTIONS OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7836, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE “PHILIPPINE TEACHERS PROFESSIONALIZATION ACT OF 1994” AS AMENDED BY REPUBLIC ACT NO. 9293
rows.abstract:
Seeks to widen the nomination for the members of the Board of Professional Teachers by including the Teachers Education Council (TEC), DepEd, accredited association of private schools and school administrators, and CHED - in choosing nominees in addition to the accredited association of teachers.

Proposes for the following:  

Issuance of appropriate rules by the PRC that will govern the practice of members of the Board to avoid conflict of interest in the conduct of licensure examination and release of results; recognition of the probationary employment of a teacher as an exception to the requirement of professional license in the practice of teaching subject to certain conditions; additional academic qualifications for applicants who will take the licensure examination for teachers; requirement of a refresher course for those who have failed to pass the licensure examination for three times.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING MECHANISMS THAT SHALL ENSURE THE EFFECTIVE  IMPLEMENTATION OF A NATIONWIDE TREE PLANTING PROGRAM, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 10176, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE “ARBOR DAY ACT OF 2012”
rows.title_short: Providing Mechanisms That Shall Ensure The Effective  Implementation Of A Nationwide Tree Planting Program, Amending For The Purpose Republic Act No. 10176, Otherwise Known As The “ Arbor Day Act Of 2012”
rows.abstract:
Aims to rehabilitate denuded forests, improve soil fertility and land productivity, and reduce soil erosion by undertaking nationwide tree planting activities and providing effective measures for their maintenance and sustainability.
Seeks to include the National Commission of Indigenous Peoples (NCIP) among the members of the Arbor Day Celebration Committee which shall be selected by the concerned local chief executive.
Mandates the LGU, with the technical assistance from the DENR to identify the suitable areas to be planted to various species of trees and plants.
Tasks the DILG to monitor the implementation of this Act and submit an annual report to the Congressional Oversight Committee on the areas identified in each LGU that are suitable to tree planting and reforestation.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2023-08-22, transmitted to the Senate on 2023-08-23 and received by the Senate on 2023-08-23
